(주)락토메이슨 제3공장 제조 · 경질캡슐 1캡슐(270mg) · 1일 1회

  • 표시 기준량 270mg = 1캡슐 = 하루 섭취량 — 계산이 필요 없습니다

  • 붕해시험 20분 이내 — 식약처 신고 기준
  • 흰노랑색 분말을 함유한 장방형 백색 경질캡슐 · (주)락토메이슨 제3공장 제조

1일 1회1회 1캡슐(270mg)물 등과 같이

프로바이오틱스 수 표시량 10,000,000,000(100억) CFU/270mg 이상
성상 흰노랑색 분말을 함유한 장방형 백색의 경질캡슐
붕해시험 20분 이내
대장균군 음성
유통기한 제조일로부터 24개월까지
보관 직사광선을 피해 실온에서 보관

drafts.en:
Health Functional Food10 billion CFU per capsule1 capsule 270 mg = labelled basis

Health & WellnessProbiotics · Gut health

Made by Lactomason Plant 3 · Hard capsule (270 mg) · Once a day

The labelled basis of 270 mg and one capsule of 270 mg are the same — so the 10 billion CFU in one capsule is the daily amount. Probiotics are recognized by Korea's MFDS as an ingredient that may help promote lactic acid bacteria growth and suppress harmful bacteria, may help support smooth bowel movement, and may help support gut health.

Why this product

  • Labelled basis 270 mg = 1 capsule = daily serving — no calculation needed
  • 10 billion CFU of probiotics per capsule
  • Disintegration within 20 minutes — its MFDS notified standard
  • White oblong hard capsule containing pale yellow powder · Made by Lactomason Plant 3
  • Coliform negative — meets its MFDS notified standard

Directions (exactly as officially stated)

Once a day1 capsule (270 mg) per servingWith water

Labelled standard

Probiotic count At least 10,000,000,000 (10 billion) CFU per 270 mg
Appearance White oblong hard capsule containing pale yellow powder
Disintegration Within 20 minutes
Coliform Negative
Shelf life Up to 24 months from manufacture
Storage Room temperature, away from direct sunlight

Who it suits

  • Those who want one capsule a day
  • Those who prefer a smaller capsule
Precautions · Consult a professional if you have a medical condition or take medication · Allergic reactions may occur in sensitive individuals · Keep out of reach of children and follow the stated daily intake · Stop use and consult a professional if adverse effects occur

  • 흰노랑색의 분말 · (주)허브큐어 제조
